bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Glen of Imaal Terrier social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Glen of Imaal Terrier exposure.
Weight range 32-40 lb (14.5-18 kg) and grooming needs (Wiry coat.) belong in the same Glen of Imaal Terrier household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Glen of Imaal Terrier is also monitored for hip dysplasia, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Glen of Imaal Terrier appointments.
After the Glen of Imaal Terrier puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Glen of Imaal Terrier shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or progressive retinal atrophy (pra) worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Glen of Imaal Terrier make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Glen of Imaal Terrier antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Glen of Imaal Terrier dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this small dog.
Reset the Glen of Imaal Terrier reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Glen of Imaal Terrier core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Glen of Imaal Terrier misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Glen of Imaal Terrier health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Glen of Imaal Terrier adult health guide for breed predispositions such as progressive retinal atrophy (pra), then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
